title: Eiliko maker says it’s hiring an ‘independent security firm’ after Verge report on its insecure robots
hook_text: Your bag charm is spying on you.
script:
Energize Lab built Eiliko, a cute AI robot charm you can hang on your bag.
The device features built in AI conversations and promised owners their secrets were safe.
The Verge found that hackers could easily read complete transcripts of everything told to the toy.
Energize Lab responded by announcing it is hiring an independent security firm.
The security lapse exposed private voice data meant to stay completely private.
Would you trust a smart toy with your voice data?
